_readme: Presentation-only data for the portfolio page (src/index.html): logos, badge links, featured tools. Facts about Hari (roles, projects, skills, clients) live in profile.json, which the page also reads, so AskHari.ai and the page stay in sync.

strengths.title: Data platforms
strengths.proof: Enterprise platforms on Spark, Kafka, dbt, Databricks and Data Vault for e-commerce, retail, telecom and biotech clients.

strengths.title: GenAI & RAG
strengths.proof: Production RAG and agentic AI on enterprise data, from Snowflake Cortex AI agents to Claude-powered assistants.

strengths.title: Multi-cloud architecture
strengths.proof: Data platforms across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, plus Snowflake and Databricks, built with Terraform, Kubernetes and CI/CD.

strengths.title: Delivery leadership
strengths.proof: 10+ years owning delivery end to end: architecture reviews, quality audits, mentoring and stakeholder alignment.

_pipeline: Drives the live pipeline panel in the hub hero (src/home.njk): one row per stage, with the first name in `where` shown on the right, each fact paraphrased from a project in profile.json. `tool` picks a logo from `tools`; `icon` picks a built-in glyph (ingest, check, insight).
